lens: E - US and Asian trends not yet in the EU
slice: D4 - kids, family, hobby, office and desk

ideas.name: Nordic Techo Planner + Refills
ideas.concept: Hobonichi-style thin-paper (Tomoe River-type) day-per-page planner with Danish/Swedish layouts, school-term and holiday grids, cover plus annual refill.
ideas.target_customer: Scandinavian women 20-40, journaling and desk-aesthetic communities on TikTok/Instagram
ideas.problem_solved: No local-language, premium-paper, refillable day-per-page planner; imports from Japan are pricey and English/Japanese-only.
ideas.trend_evidence: Bloomberg reports TikTok propelled the 2026 Hobonichi Techo to virality, with over 1M copies sold; Papier (UK) doubled sales 2022-2025 on analog demand. No Nordic-language equivalent verified (not exhaustively checked).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Nordic-language layouts and school calendars, annual refill subscription lock-in, designer cover collaborations; paper supplier exclusivity.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (print plates only, die for cover optional)

ideas.name: Deco Kit: Nordic Sticker-Flake Journal Set
ideas.concept: Korean 'dakku'-style diary-decoration kit: designed sticker flake sheets, washi, stamps and a memo pad in a flat box, with seasonal refill packs.
ideas.target_customer: Teens and 20-30s journalers, junk-journal and bullet-journal fans in SE/DK
ideas.problem_solved: Decorative journaling supplies in EU are generic or imported from Asia with slow shipping and no local design.
ideas.trend_evidence: Korea Times and Asiae describe a 'customization/dakku' boom with Daiso Korea running decoration fairs; Michaels reports junk-journaling searches up 63% YoY. EU-specific demand not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Original illustration IP and seasonal collections; sticker sets are low-copy-cost but art is copyrightable and collectible drops drive repeat.

ideas.name: Small-Parts Kid Organizer File (Komagoma-style)
ideas.concept: Upright-standing, clear-window A5 organizer file with many mini compartments for LEGO minifig parts, beads, cards, craft bits; Nordic colours.
ideas.target_customer: Parents of 5-10 year olds and hobbyists (beads, cards, minifigs)
ideas.problem_solved: Small hobby pieces get lost; kids cannot see or find items in boxes.
ideas.trend_evidence: Sakura Komagoma File won Design Award at Japan's 2026 stationery awards and went viral as a children's organizing tool. No EU equivalent verified; note Sakura is an established brand so direct copy is not an option.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own compartment layout and hobby-specific variants (card, bead, minifig sets) with design registration; flat PP sheet welding avoids injection tooling.
ideas.tooling_needed: Cutting/welding die for PP sheet ~EUR 300-800; no injection mould

ideas.name: Fold-Flat Magnetic Pen Stand Case
ideas.concept: Silicone or fabric pen case that unfolds into an upright magnetic pen stand on desk or steel surface, with a recycled-material Scandi design.
ideas.problem_solved: Pen cases clutter desks and pens are hard to see; no single object works as carry case and stand.
ideas.trend_evidence: Yanko Design (Jul 2026) and Trendhunter cover Sonic Kakusta convertible pen stand; Sun-Star pen cases won 2026 awards. Concept already exists via Japanese imports, so copy risk is high.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak on mechanism alone; defend via design patent/registered design, material (recycled silicone), and bundling with desk sets. Magnets are small, check toy/GPSR rules.

ideas.name: Modular Build-Your-Own Desk Sorter for Kids
ideas.concept: Snap/slot recycled-board or sheet-PP modules that kids assemble and customise with stickers into a homework desk organizer.
ideas.target_customer: Parents of 6-12 year olds in SE/DK; schools
ideas.problem_solved: Kids' desks are messy; fixed organizers do not fit their needs, and assembly doubles as a craft activity.
ideas.trend_evidence: A China stationery sourcing guide names build-your-own desk sorters as a key student product and blind-box style stationery as growing; it is a supplier blog, not verified demand data. Weak signal.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own modular system and add-on module ecosystem (repeat purchase), registered design; low barrier otherwise.

ideas.name: Premium Photocard/Trading Card Collect Binder Set
ideas.concept: Sturdy fabric-bound 4-pocket binder with acid-free sleeves, magnetic closure and matching toploader pack, positioned for K-pop and TCG collectors.
ideas.target_customer: Teen and young-adult collectors (K-pop photocards, Pokemon, sports cards)
ideas.problem_solved: Collectors complain of cheap packaging and materials; existing binders are generic.
ideas.trend_evidence: K-pop merchandise market estimates around USD 5B in 2025 growing about 10% CAGR; Europe TCG market around USD 1.34B at 7.6% CAGR (market-report claims, low authority). No product-level EU trend verified; segment has established brands.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fandom collaborations and artist-designed covers; weak otherwise, competitive accessory market.
